## 6. Intern Checklist

Please check each item only after verifying it. If an item does not apply, mark it **N/A** with a short explanation.

- [ ] I followed the scope and acceptance criteria in my assigned task.
- [ ] I kept changes limited to the files needed for the task and its tests/docs.
- [ ] I verified that no secrets, passwords, tokens, or live API keys are committed; `.env` and other secret files are ignored.
- [ ] Applicable SQL uses parameterised queries; no ORM was introduced where the project requires raw SQL. (Otherwise: N/A.)
- [ ] I added or updated relevant unit/integration tests and ran them locally.
- [ ] I ran applicable lint, type-check, and build commands.
- [ ] I updated the relevant documentation in `docs/`, if required. (Otherwise: N/A.)
- [ ] I synced/rebased with the latest `main` and resolved any merge conflicts.
- [ ] I requested review from one teammate and the domain lead.
